prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1116; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented after a sideswipe collision that occurred while changing lanes, reporting pain and swelling in the right wrist. Examination showed focal tenderness and reduced grip, and imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with this type of injury. The patient was seen on three occasions. Treatment followed a typical course, including immobilization, pain management, and a graduated return to activity, and it was tapered as the patient's symptoms and range of motion improved. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same region, which resolved completely and did not affect the current presentation. Billing records reflect the visits and treatment provided, with no repeated or duplicate charges. Imaging and examination findings clearly support the diagnosis. Follow-up is recommended if symptoms recur or function does not continue to improve.
